description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of characteristics associated with the “Uncrushable” and “Unhackable” problem sets, as described in the referenced paper. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different characteristic: Complexity, Instance, Scalable, Oversight, Coverage, and Autoverifiable. The slices are colored orange, blue, red, brown, green, and light green, respectively. The “Complexity” slice appears to represent approximately 25% of the chart, while “Instance” occupies roughly 15%. “Scalable” and “Oversight” each take up approximately 12.5%, “Coverage” is around 20%, and “Autoverifiable” appears to represent approximately 15% of the chart. A legend is present, labeling each slice with its corresponding characteristic. No slices are visually emphasized, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting with “Complexity”. Percentage labels are not displayed within the slices themselves.
